services_heading: Complete Fencing, Building & Gardening Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From fence repairs and new installations to garden landscaping and building works, we handle residential and commercial projects with care.

services.title: Fence Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New timber, composite or metal fencing tailored to your garden and budget. We handle groundwork, post setting and finishing to last 10+ years.

services.title: Fence Repair & Maintenance
services.desc: Damaged panels, loose posts, rot damage — we fix it fast. Regular maintenance extends fence life and keeps your property secure.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Create the garden you've always wanted. Patio laying, raised beds, decking, planting schemes and hard landscaping all handled in-house.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear, remove waste and leave you with a blank canvas ready for design or simply maintained and neat.

services.title: Decking & Outdoor Structures
services.desc: Hardwood or composite decking, pergolas and garden structures built to withstand Nottingham weather and add real value to your home.

services.title: Building & Groundwork Services
services.desc: Small building projects, foundations, paths and drainage work carried out by our experienced team with full site safety.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own garden — no shortcuts, just honest work and fair prices.
about_para_1: MP Building was established over 15 years ago by Mark, a tradesman fed up with seeing homeowners overcharged and let down by unreliable contractors. What started as a one-man fencing operation has grown into a small team of skilled builders, fencers and gardeners serving Carlton, Nottingham and beyond. We're proud to have completed over 500 residential and commercial projects without cutting corners.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, delivering exactly what we've quoted, and treating your property with respect. We stock quality materials, carry all tools needed, and clear up after ourselves — every time. Customers come back because they know they'll get a fair price, skilled work, and someone who actually listens to what they want.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our garden fence. Mark came out, quoted us honestly, and finished the work in two days. Posts are solid, panels are straight, and the price was way better than the other lads we asked. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with Japanese knotweed in the garden. These guys cleared the lot, disposed of it properly, and levelled the ground ready for new planting. Professional and thorough. Saved us a fortune compared to specialist firms.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Called about a damaged fence panel and Mark fitted a replacement the next day. No faffing about, no inflated bill. That's how it should be. He's now my go-to for any outdoor work. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Robert P.
